# TradeSite

TradeSite designs websites for New Zealand trade businesses. The offer is a free, personalised website draft within 24 hours. The customer pays only if they want the finished site.

## Pages

- Home: /
- Websites for tradies: /websites-for-tradies
- Pricing: /pricing
- How it works: /how-it-works
- Work examples: /portfolio
- Free draft: /get-a-draft
- Guides: /blog
- Electrician websites: /trades/electrician-websites
- Plumber websites: /trades/plumber-websites
- Builder websites: /trades/builder-websites
- Roofer websites: /trades/roofer-websites
- Painter websites: /trades/painter-websites
- Landscaper websites: /trades/landscaper-websites

Prices are published in NZD and exclude GST until the business is GST registered. Portfolio pages are concept designs, not client projects.
